rootCause: PromExporter sets response expiration to 5 seconds; AdmissionRuntime publishes asynchronously. Consecutive scrape calls can observe different cached responses.
fix: Wait for and assert the same captured converged peak=16, instead of performing a second potentially stale scrape. Fresh API restart before successful final test.
interpretationLimit: Formal backend /metrics samples can lag by cache TTL; external cgroup/RSS/FD and SQL/Redis samples are collected independently.
